channel.title: Long Island Business News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Long Island Business News (libn.com)

item.title: $1.5M NYS funding expands Northwell gun violence prevention program
item.description: New York State invests $1.5 million to expand Northwell Health’s firearm injury prevention program to Buffalo, Rochester, and the Bronx emergency departments.

item.title: $130M Mineola condo project advances with IDA approval
item.description: The Nassau County IDA approved economic incentives for The Bridge, a $130 million condo project with 101 units near Mineola LIRR station, set to start construction soon.

item.title: Long island professionals adopt cautious AI use amid skepticism
item.description: Long Island professionals use AI cautiously, emphasizing human oversight in marketing, legal, and analytics fields despite growing AI adoption and investment.

item.title: Shopping center magnate David Simon dies at 64
item.description: David Simon, CEO of Simon Property Group, died at 64 after battling cancer. He led major acquisitions and grew the company into a retail real estate giant.

item.title: Certilman Balin names new co-chairs of commercial lending group
item.description: Certilman Balin appoints new co-chairs of its Commercial Lending Practice Group

item.title: Molloy offers direct path from bachelor’s to PhD in nursing
item.description: Molloy University in Rockville Centre introduces a direct BS-to-PhD nursing program starting fall 2026 to address nurse faculty shortages and prepare future educators

item.title: Nationwide Mortgage Bankers unveils new Melville HQ
item.description: Nationwide Mortgage Bankers has opened a new 28,552 sq ft headquarters in Melville featuring a digital media studio and conference center for industry training.

item.title: Work starts on new Patchogue medical office project
item.description: Construction has started on a $10 million medical office building at 60 Lake St. in Patchogue, led by developer Allon Avgi and built by Kulka Group.

item.title: Ex-Holbrook office manager charged with $1M payroll theft
item.description: A former Holbrook office manager was charged with stealing over $1 million by manipulating payroll from 2020 to 2025

item.title: Queens construction firm relocating to LI with new acquisition
item.description: The company acquired a 21,000-square-foot industrial property in Ronkonkoma for $5 million, relocating from Queens to Long Island.

item.title: Uniondale law firm names new co-managing partner
item.description: Ruskin Moscou Faltischek has named a new co-managing partner alongside Adam Silvers, marking a leadership transition at the Uniondale law firm

item.title: Long Island pediatrician launches autism care startup
item.description: Dr. Sania Wilkins launches I Get You, a Plainview-based virtual startup focused on early autism diagnosis and support for families across New York.

item.title: Concierge Pediatrics expands with new Bellmore lease
item.description: Concierge Pediatrics is expanding its Long Island presence with a new 3,000-square-foot location in Bellmore.

item.title: Lion’s Nook Bar &amp;amp; Grill to open in East Hampton
item.description: Lion’s Nook Bar &amp;amp; Grill, a new restaurant by Parioli Hospitality, will open in East Hampton offering American cuisine with a classic English pub vibe

item.title: Florist and spa concept Bloom coming to Station Yards
item.description: Bloom, a florist and spa concept owned by Kerry Maher Weisse, leased 4,293 square feet at Station Yards in Ronkonkoma.
